preconditions.description: The length of S must be between 1 and 10^5.
The length of pat must be between 1 and the length of S.

postconditions.expression: all(isinstance(index, int) for index in return_value)
postconditions.description: All elements in the return value must be integers.

postconditions.expression: all(1 <= index <= len(S) - len(pat) + 1 for index in return_value)
postconditions.description: All indices in the return value must be within the valid range of starting indices for pat in S.

postconditions.expression: all(S[index-1:index-1+len(pat)] == pat for index in return_value)
postconditions.description: Each index in the return value must correspond to a starting position of pat in S.

postconditions.expression: len(return_value) == sum(S[i:i+len(pat)] == pat for i in range(len(S) - len(pat) + 1))
postconditions.description: The number of indices in the return value must match the number of occurrences of pat in S.
